name: ESMFold pseudo-complex 3D features
reason: ESMFold v1 model loader requires omegaconf + openfold; missing in local env. CPU-only torch (2.11.0+cpu, cuda=False) — folding 200 peptides at ~30s/each would already exceed our 90-min budget plus install of openfold from source is non-trivial without GPU. Per Wave 8 spec: 'If ESMFold install or runtime fails, document and skip Track 8B.' Existing structural signal already covered by Wave 2 Structure_LR (BLOSUM + Kyte-Doolittle profile).
fallback_action: Track 8A (TCR) and Track 8C (self-similarity) only; 3D modality omitted from wave8_combined_features.tsv.
aux_pod_note: wave8/aux_pod/run_esmfold.py + eval_3d_standalone.py are scaffolding for a HuggingFace EsmForProteinFolding pod-GPU run (no openfold dep).
